story.titleZh: 埃德·斯特劳发布2026荷兰大奖赛F1车手排名
story.summaryZh: The 比赛的埃德·斯特劳根据荷兰大奖赛表现发布车手排名，冲刺赛赛制、赞德福特赛道布局与赛前降雨对全体车手构成考验。
story.originalTitle: Edd Straw's 2026 Dutch Grand Prix F1 driver rankings
story.summaryEn: Edd Straw of The Race has published his driver rankings from the Dutch Grand Prix, where the sprint format, the Zandvoort layout and pre-race rain tested the entire Formula 1 field.
detailZh: 把冲刺赛周末的赛制、赞德沃特赛道的高要求，以及开赛前突如其来的降雨结合在一起——最后一届（就目前而言）荷兰大奖赛已经具备了对整个F1车手阵容进行真正考验的一切要素。
谁顺利通过了这场考验，谁的希望又被击得粉碎？以下是埃德·斯特劳对荷兰站的圆桌式车手排名。
冠军级别的会员还可以亲自尝试整理出自己的车手排名，埃德将在另一篇文章中对此作出回应！
这个排名是怎么运作的？每个大奖赛周末，22位车手将按表现从最好到最差依次排名。这将基于全方位的评判标准，从速度、比赛技巧，到稳定性，以及是否犯下关键错误。每位车手距离发挥出赛车最大性能潜力有多接近，将是一个重要的考量因素。
需要注意的是，这既反映了整个周末的综合表现——要认识到排位赛实际上相当于比赛的“第0圈”，是为正赛奠定基础的关键——同时也并不是对每位车手全面实力的排名。它只是关于车手在某个特定周末的表现如何。因此，这一排名会在每个周末之间出现明显波动。
由于11支车队（注：原文如此）在根本性能潜力上各不相同，加上“运气”（即车手无法控制的因素）也会影响周末的走向，这一排名也会与最终的总成绩有明显差异。
- 他在硬胎上惊人的速度是取胜的关键，而队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里却始终无法发挥出这种速度。
- 在缠斗中表现得极为犀利，当他和对方一同追赶较慢的刘易斯·汉密尔时，抓住了机会超越了基米·安东内利。
- 甚至是迈凯伦车手中最快的，即便与皮亚斯特里的最佳表现相比也是如此。
- 本有机会争夺冲刺赛杆位，但只做出了他自称"还不错的单圈"，最终以0.041秒之差落后于拉塞尔。
- 在冲刺赛中从第二滑落至第三，不过可以说明的是，在被超越之后他的节奏显示后轮退化确实是个问题。
- 红旗之后重新发车时失去领先位置，他认为是因为抓地力较低的杆位发车格让他的比赛变得更加复杂。
结论：这很可能是他最棒的一场大奖赛胜利，为这个强势的周末画上了句号。
- 虽然他的排位赛成绩从纸面上看很差，但尾翼直线模式的故障毁掉了冲刺排位赛，而在正式排位赛第一节中，车队指挥墙在交通管理上的一些失误也让他非常恼火。
- 从维修区发车后，他跑出了一场令人印象深刻的冲刺赛，一反常规地完成了几次超车动作。
- 正赛的表现堪称一流，他是唯一真正执行了一停策略的车手，在有干净空气时充分利用了优势，随后在比赛尾声阶段将皮埃尔·加斯利牢牢挡在安全距离之外。
- 唯一的负面因素是排位赛的情况以及比赛的进程，使得很难确切地衡量他的比赛节奏。但这并不是他的错。
结论：在一个不顺利的周末之后，他证明了自己仍然能够创造一场比赛奇迹。
- 他很好地适应了红牛赛车，从一开始的练习赛起，他就比2025年年初时显得轻松得多。
- 相对于马克斯·维斯塔潘，他展现出了不错的单圈速度，尤其是在正式排位赛中，他最终只慢了十分之一秒多一点。
- 大奖赛中获得第七名已经是能做到的最好成绩了，尽管没有维斯塔潘这个标杆来衡量。
- 本有望在冲刺赛排位赛中进入前十，却未能在第二节排位赛（SQ2）中跟上不断改善的抓地力。考虑到超车非常困难，这注定了他在冲刺赛中一分未得。
大奖赛本身很平淡，因为他的赛车没有足够的速度威胁前面的车手，但确实领先于中游集团。
黄旗违规处罚可能没有影响他的最终名次，但这本是一次不必要的处罚。
结论：考虑到他在周五之前从未驾驶过小红牛22，这已经达到了他所能期待的成绩上限。
- 与大幅升级的阿尔派（阿尔派）磨合良好，并在周末的冲刺环节表现出色，在排位赛和正赛中都拿到了可能取得的最好结果。
- 在因埃斯特班·奥康（奥康）引发虚拟安全车而重启比赛时，突袭了角田裕毅，将第11位转化为一个积分。
- 他在大奖赛中的比赛节奏不错，尽管一度被阿维德·林德布拉德（Arvid Lindblad）那辆如同移动路障的小红牛赛车所压制。
——周六第二节排位赛中没有把赛车的性能完全发挥出来，不过这主要是由于车队在交通管理方面出现了混乱。
- 相对弗朗哥·科拉平托的节奏优势没有意义，因为只有加斯利用上了升级套件。
结论：很好地适应了升级后的阿尔派。
- 将本周末冲刺赛环节中一切可能做到的事情发挥到了极致，从杆位起步并赢得胜利。
- 虽然他不一定是梅赛德斯车队中更快的那位车手，但就整个周末来看，他是表现更稳健的那一个。
- 在让过队友之后，他打了一场精彩的防守战，成功挡住汉密尔顿，保住了领奖台位置。
- 他本来有机会争夺大奖赛的杆位，但在11号弯用力过猛，导致轮胎温度飙升，这使他与诺里斯的较量形势急转直下。
- 他在发车时被安东内利超越，随后在重启时又被皮亚斯特里超越，这让他的夺冠机会大打折扣。
结论：在周末的冲刺赛部分表现出色，但在大奖赛中遇到了更多困难。
- 在冲刺赛中跑出了一场精彩的比赛，是仅有的两位使用软胎起头的车手之一，超越诺里斯后以第二名完赛。
- 他在不同轮胎配方下的比赛节奏都很好，并在大奖赛中完成了一次对皮亚斯特里的精彩超越。
- 第一次虚拟安全车（VSC）出现的时机对他在大奖赛中与汉密尔顿的较量不利，而他在那次较量中原本占据优势。
detailEn: Combine the sprint weekend format, the demands of the Zandvoort circuit, and rain just before the start - and the final edition of the Dutch Grand Prix (for the time being) had enough about it to properly test the Formula 1 field.
Who came out of that test unscathed and whose hopes were torpedoed? Here are Edd Straw's driver rankings from the Netherlands.
Champions-tier members can also try their hand at putting their own driver rankings together for Edd to react to in a separate feature!

How do the rankings work? The 22 drivers will be ranked in order of performance from best to worst on each grand prix weekend. This will be based on the full range of criteria, ranging from pace and racecraft to consistency and whether they made key mistakes. How close each driver got to delivering on the maximum performance potential of the car will be an essential consideration.

It’s important to note both that this reflects performance across the entire weekend, cognisant of the fact that qualifying is effectively ‘lap 0’ of the race and key to laying the foundations to the race, and that it is not a ranking of the all-round qualities of each driver. It’s simply about how they performed on a given weekend. Therefore, the ranking will fluctuate significantly from weekend to weekend.

And with each of the 11 cars fundamentally having different performance potential and ‘luck’ (ie factors outside of a driver’s control) contributing to the way the weekend plays out, this ranking will also differ significantly from the overall results.
- His stunning pace on the hard tyres, which team-mate Oscar Piastri couldn't switch on, was key to his victory.
- Razor-sharp in battle to take the opportunity to pass Kimi Antonelli when the pair were chasing the slower Lewis Hamilton.
- Was the faster McLaren driver even compared to Piastri's best work.
- Had a shot at sprint pole, but only produced what he called a "reasonable lap" to end up 0.041s behind George Russell.
- Slipped from second to third in the sprint, although in mitigation his pace after being passed showed the rear tyre degradation was a problem.
- Losing the lead at the restart from what he felt was the lower-grip pole position grid box after the red flag complicated his race.
Verdict: Probably his best grand prix win capped a strong weekend.

- While his qualifying performances looked poor on paper, the failure of straight mode in the rear wing ruined sprint qualifying, with some traffic-management errors from the pitwall infuriating him in Q1 proper.
- Drove an impressive sprint race after starting from the pits, going against convention by making some overtaking manoeuvres.
- Race drive was high-class, as he was the only driver to execute a de facto one-stopper and made the most of clear air when he had it, then kept Pierre Gasly at arm's length in the closing stages.
- The only negative is that qualifying circumstances and the way the races played out made it difficult to benchmark his pace definitively. But that's not his fault.
Verdict: Showed he could still produce a race miracle after a troubled weekend.
- Adapted well to the Red Bull and looked dramatically more comfortable than he did in early 2025 from the start of practice.
- Showed good single-lap pace relative to Max Verstappen, particularly in main qualifying as he ended up just over a tenth-of-a-second slower.
- Seventh in the grand prix was as good as it was going to get, albeit without the yardstick of Verstappen to measure it by.
- Was on target to make the top 10 in sprint qualifying, only to struggle to go with the improving grip in SQ2. Given how hard it was to pass, that doomed him to a pointless sprint.
- The grand prix itself was straightforward given he had a car that didn't have the pace to threaten those ahead, but was clear of the midfield.
- Yellow-flag infringement penalty may not have impacted his finishing position, but it was a needless penalty.
Verdict: At the upper limit of what he could have expected to achieve given he had never driven the RB22 before Friday.
- Gelled well with the heavily upgraded Alpine and excelled in the sprint parts of the weekend, getting the best-possible result in qualifying and the race.
- Ambushed Yuki Tsunoda at the restart from the Esteban Ocon-induced virtual safety car to turn 11th place into a point.
- Race pace was good in the grand prix, although he was contained for a spell by Arvid Lindblad's rolling-roadblock Racing Bulls.
- Didn't get the most out of the car in Q2 on Saturday, although that was largely down to the team's confused traffic management.
- Pace advantage over Franco Colapinto is meaningless given only Gasly had the upgrade.
Verdict: Adapted well to upgraded Alpine.
- Maximised what was possible in the sprint component of the weekend, winning from pole position.
- While he wasn't necessarily the faster Mercedes driver, taking the weekend as a whole he was the tidier one.
- Brilliant rearguard action to hold off Hamilton salvaged a podium, after letting through his team-mate.
- Had a shot at pole position for the grand prix, but overdid it into Turn 11 and spiked the tyre temperatures, which swung the battle with Norris against him.
- Lost out to Antonelli at the start, then Piastri at the restart, which meant his victory chances took a big hit.
Verdict: Outstanding in the sprint part of the weekend, but struggled a little more in the grand prix.
- Drove an excellent race in the sprint as one of only two drivers to start on softs, passing Norris to finish second.
- Race pace was good across compounds, and he made a good pass on Piastri in the grand prix.
- The timing of the first VSC went against him in the grand prix battle with Hamilton that he initially had the advantage in.
keyPointsZh: 排名基于速度、比赛技术、稳定性及关键失误等多重标准
车手是否发挥出赛车最大性能潜力是核心考量
这可能是暂时意义上的最后一届荷兰大奖赛
keyPointsEn: The rankings are based on criteria including pace, racecraft, consistency and key mistakes
How close each driver got to the car's maximum performance potential is a key consideration
This was the final Dutch Grand Prix for the time being

detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔夺得杆位，梅赛德斯车队在卡塔尔大奖赛排位赛中占据领先，这是自5月份加拿大大奖赛以来的首次。
以下是排位赛三部分的全部结果：

Here are the full results from all three parts of qualifying:

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.

国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
